description: Nestled on a quiet cul-de-sac south of Ventura Boulevard in a prime Encino location, this exceptional residence offers the perfect blend of comfort, elegance, and functionality while presenting a wonderful opportunity to update and remodel into a truly spectacular estate. The primarily single-story floor plan with over 3800 sq. ft. includes a versatile two-room upstairs bonus wing, offering flexible space ideal for a private office suite, game room, gym, or creative studio. Boasting five bedrooms, including a maid’s room, and four bathrooms, the home welcomes you through double doors into a grand foyer that leads to a dramatic step-down living room with a fireplace. An adjacent lounge room with vaulted beamed ceilings and a wet bar creates the perfect setting for entertaining, while a separate family room provides additional gathering space. Hardwood floors flow throughout the main entertaining areas, enhancing the home’s warm and inviting atmosphere. The banquet-sized formal dining room is ideal for hosting large gatherings, while the gourmet kitchen is appointed with granite countertops, a center island, an eating area, stainless refrigerator/freezer, Viking six-burner range with double ovens, and a walk-in pantry. The luxurious primary suite features a walk-in closet and a spa-inspired bathroom with dual pedestal sinks, a soaking tub, and separate shower. The lush backyard offers breathtaking views of majestic trees, serene mountains, and sparkling valley lights. Designed for resort-style living and entertaining, the rear grounds include a pool and spa, built-in barbecue, and expansive deck. With its outstanding floor plan, generous scale, and premier location near Ventura Boulevard’s renowned shopping and dining, this property is the perfect canvas for a buyer to renovate, reimagine, and elevate it to its full potential. Located within the highly sought-after Encino Charter Elementary School district, this is a rare opportunity to create a dream home in one of Encino’s most desirable neighborhoods.
